text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Satsuki Sho had always
been out of
reach for the Mejiros... But
today is different.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright finishes first! Within the
long, long
history of the Mejiro family,
they've finally
received the Satsuki Sho
crown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Bright, Bright, Briiiight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're incredible, just incredible... I
swear it,
you're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan... Are you really this happy? You're going to make me... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Ryan... Thank you for watching
me race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was finally able to bring light to
the
Mejiros and help Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Help me? What do you mean, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Mejiro Ryan about Mejiro Bright's
secret
goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. I'm really thankful, Bright,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You never had to carry that burden. If
you carry
too much on your shoulders,
you'll end up like I
did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Like you did?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think the reason I didn't do well
at the
Triple Crown was because I had
too much on my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why you have to run for yourself.
That's the
best way you can run for the
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Run to make yourself happy. That's more

important than anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah... Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I... I really love you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wha?! I mean, I'm really happy to
hear
that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, do your best at the Japanese
Derby!
That means you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby... I still can't see the
path
before me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Should I continue running the way I have
been?
Or...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright ran the Satsuki Sho to
make up for
what happened in the past.
But the Japanese
Derby...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Will be a fight for the future.
